comparison.objective: Carry a full cup safely around a laptop versus tune and lock an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable transport and obstacle clearance versus tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, force-limited locking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Cup upright on coaster without spill or laptop approach versus two safe carriage stops within stroke and lock-drift limits.
comparison.reason: Shared caution and physical actuation are generic; the tested abilities differ. Candidate rubric lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift, and tightening limits.
